title: dryopteris thelypteris f. linearis
intro: Dryopteris thelypteris f. linearis, commonly known as the linear-leaved wood fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual cramps due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating a range of conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris thelypteris f. linearis include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
